children: said on Monday it had signed a contract worth nearly €1 billion ($1.2 billion) to develop and build 18 satellites for the European Union's IRIS² secure communications programme.
The contract, awarded by satellite operator SES
, is the first major industrial order announced under the EU's IRIS² constellation, Europe's flagship effort to develop sovereign satellite communication capabilities.
SES is responsible for the programme's medium-Earth orbit segment within the SpaceRISE consortium, which also includes Eutelsat
The first IRIS² satellites are scheduled for launch in 2029, with initial services expected from 2030.
